surat.headline: Surat cluster shows diamond demand upticks and LGD surges alongside textile fraud and fire disruptions.
what_changed: Surat diamond units cut Diwali vacations from 25 days to 7 days due to a demand rally.
Polyester FDY prices dropped 6.96% and staple fibre fell 4.33% due to lower crude and freight rates.
GJEPC reported a 96% surge in LGD exports and a 19% increase in natural diamond exports.
stress_signals: Veer Creation operators fled, cheating Surat textile traders of 43.54 lakh rupees in grey fabric fraud [e15e6b4c5b22].
Multiple fire incidents reported, including a textile godown fire lasting over 32 hours and a building fire housing textile units [47888fb89bb1, 70735ded426a].
improvement_signals: Gem and jewellery exports surged 34.01 percent ahead of Christmas demand [c3b68570a07d].
Diamond units shortened holiday breaks due to strong market demand at the start of the new year [52a0d9ea7bbb, 20dc10f35062].
what_to_watch: Monitor inventory and insurance coverage for textile units following recent godown and building fires.
Track trade credit defaults and receivables in the textile trading segment following the grey fabric fraud incident.
Watch natural diamond price pressure and resale market impacts driven by rising lab-grown diamond output [3d642383c7eb, e3a72bc7c6f3].
